stem.en: What must happen before the cell can divide?

text.en: It must accurately duplicate its DNA so each new cell gets a complete set of instructions.
It must dissolve its outer membrane.

feedback.en: The cell membrane remains intact for most of the division process. Destroying it would kill the cell

text.en: It must permanently destroy all its organelles.

feedback.en: Daughter cells need organelles to survive. Many organelles are shared or duplicated during cell division, not destroyed.

explanation.en: DNA must be copied accurately before division so that both daughter cells inherit a complete set of genetic instructions.
